INSERT INTO ecom_fee_allocation (settlement_id, settlement_item_id, store_id, seller_sku, item_type, method, alloc_date, basis_value, amount, amount_base, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.settlementId}, #{i.settlementItemId}, #{i.storeId}, #{i.sellerSku}, #{i.itemType}, #{i.method}, #{i.allocDate}, #{i.basisValue}, #{i.amount}, #{i.amountBase}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM ecom_fee_allocation a WHERE a.settlement_id = #{settlementId} ORDER BY a.settlement_item_id, a.id

SELECT oi.seller_sku AS "sellerSku", SUM(oi.qty) AS qty, SUM(CASE WHEN t.line_sum > 0 THEN (oi.amount + COALESCE(oi.shipping, 0) + COALESCE(oi.tax, 0) - COALESCE(oi.discount, 0)) / t.line_sum * o.total_base ELSE o.total_base / t.cnt END) AS sales FROM ecom_order_item oi JOIN ecom_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN (SELECT oi2.order_id, SUM(oi2.amount + COALESCE(oi2.shipping, 0) + COALESCE(oi2.tax, 0) - COALESCE(oi2.discount, 0)) AS line_sum, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ecom_order_item oi2 JOIN ecom_order o2 ON o2.id = oi2.order_id WHERE o2.store_id = #{storeId} AND o2.order_time >= #{begin} AND o2.order_time < #{end} GROUP BY oi2.order_id) t ON t.order_id = o.id WHERE o.store_id = #{storeId} AND o.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND o.order_time >= #{begin} AND o.order_time < #{end} GROUP BY oi.seller_sku ORDER BY oi.seller_sku
